answer_1.quote: Although modern abstractive summarization systems have improved in their ability to produce fluent text , their ability to generate text that is factually grounded in the source article remains an issue .

answer_2.quote: We investigate their abilities to distinguish faithful summaries from their minimally edited counterparts.

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk. 2 To obtain fine-grained performance evaluations of faithfulness metrics, it is critical to evaluate their sensitivity regarding various error types.
answer_4.guideline: annotators to introduce an error of the required type through a minimal edit to the reference summary
